items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Donahue, you know, Jimmy -- you know Jimmy Donahue of the Woolworth millions? Well, he was the one that sang Long Live Haile Selassie during the war when he was in Italy.

ctx.x: Yes, Jimmy Daniels. We fix big dinners and things and we -- just us -- we get to talking about Paris. And incidentally, one of the places in Paris where Brick has one of her nightclubs, I'm sitting -- Mabel, Brick -- no, Brick is standing. A little fellow named Louie Coles, who was -- oh, he was marvelous. Everybody was crazy about him. He was a marvelous little singer and dancer.
Now, Jimmy Donahue, you know, Jimmy -- you know Jimmy Donahue of the Woolworth millions? Well, he was the one that sang Long Live Haile Selassie during the war when he was in Italy.
